description: Search the graph the way a query is written, not as a literal string: every word must match, a word matches the beginning of a longer one, and the best matches come first. Use it instead of search_nodes when the query is more than one word, or when a word may be spelled differently — ports for port. search_nodes is the literal-substring search and stays for exactly that. A word that matches nothing makes the result empty rather than failing the call.

entityType.description: Keep only entities of exactly this type; omit to match every type

limit.description: The most entities to return; omit for all of them

offset.description: How many ranked results to skip before the page; omit for none

name: find_nodes

observations.description: An array of observation contents associated with the entity

from.description: The name of the entity where the relation starts

to.description: The name of the entity where the relation ends

title: Find Nodes
